chunks: So he built the ark; and when groups of his people passed by him, they scoffed at him. He said to them: 'Though you laugh at us (now), we shall laugh at you, as you are laughing at us.'
ai.seo_question: What was Noah's response to his people's mockery when he built the ark?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Hud, Prophet Noah (peace be upon him) constructs the ark under divine command, enduring the ridicule of his people who fail to grasp the spiritual significance of his labor. He counters their mockery with a prophetic declaration that their derision will be met with a similar fate of divine retribution, a theme echoed in Shia exegesis as a warning against the arrogance of the disbelievers. This interaction highlights the contrast between the steadfastness of the prophet and the transient nature of his critics' scorn.
